scientific_question: Is the A2 directed-loop fluctuation discovered at J2/J1=0.125 selectively enhanced in the triangular frustrated window, and does its A1 return beat matched Krylov as a variational direction?
response_rule: All exact checks must be below 1e-10; A2 must dominate all three fresh 0.125 replications and at least 15/18 held-out rows; held-out QSL-to-ordered mean A2 residual-capture and SMA-susceptibility-proxy ratios must exceed 1.25, while the SMA-gap ratio must be below 0.90.
variational_rule: On at least 15/18 held-out rows, the A2 return must beat matched degree-2 Krylov and the complete labelled bank must beat matched degree-4 Krylov.
forbidden_actions: change coupling windows, seeds, steps, learning rate, channels, or thresholds after seeing results
include the 0.125 discovery point in phase-selectivity ratios
call m0 an exact susceptibility or the SMA proxy a thermodynamic observable
promote a new energy architecture when response gates pass but matched-Krylov gates fail
launch N36 energy training from this scan without a separate preregistration
